versions.changelog:
- 新增默认封面图片资源：加入 assets/default_cover.png，用于图片加载失败时的备用显示。
- 移除 skill-card.md 文件，精简冗余文档内容。
- 其他功能、使用方式和API无变动。

Initial release of “multi-content-feed”—a daily all-platform content export feed tool.

- Scans six major platforms (公众号/抖音/视频号/小红书/快手/B站) daily and lists Top 50 export works.
- Provides topic clustering, platform tags, cover images, engagement data, and creative insights in a visual HTML report.
- Supports filtering by platform, keyword, and date/time range; daily data updates at 15:00 for the previous day.
- Enforces user confirmation before querying dates with no data—no automatic data fetch.
- Includes one-click installation, API key via environment variable, caching, and Markdown/HTML report export.
- Detailed usage scenarios, troubleshooting, and core feature documentation provided.
